truthPosition.note: noise-free position on the true route, for validation

truthEdge.note: chicago-roads edge index the vehicle was on at each fix

truthEdgeOffset.note: distance along the true edge from its source

routeOffsets.note: ground-truth edge sequence of trace i = routeEdges[routeOffsets[i]..routeOffsets[i+1]-1]

routeEdges.note: chicago-roads directed edge indices in travel order

properties.description: SIMULATED (synthetic) GPS traces for map matching: random shortest paths on chicago-roads, sampled every 5-15 s with 10-25 m Gaussian noise and occasional dropouts. Ground-truth edge sequences are included. Not real vehicle data.
storyNotes: SIMULATED data: 200 traces, 27,605 fixes, produced by routing random origin-destination pairs (7-25 min free-flow) on chicago-roads; not real vehicles.
Noise: per-trace Gaussian sigma 10-25 m per axis (radial RMS error 25.7 m), sampling every 5-15 s, 0-3 dropouts of 30-90 s per trace; speed is 55-85% of the posted limit.
Median trace has 123 fixes over 22 min; routes cross 15,926 edges in total (median 78 per trace).

Ground truth: truthEdge per fix and routeEdges per trace let a map-matching tool report edge accuracy; noise on dense downtown blocks (~100 m) is comparable to block spacing, so it is genuinely ambiguous there.
